about_the_game:
CONTENT:

A game with various intertwined themes and subjects, featuring an immersive story. Funny characters. Soundtracks tailored to each theme. Maps include: Hell, Europe in WWII, various countries worldwide, multicultural-themed maps. Christmas-themed maps, space-themed and more futuristic maps, or mythological themes. A dark story with BLACK AND GREEN HUMOR, with references to Wolfenstein and Half-Life (WE DO NOT USE LOGOS OR COPY CHARACTERS; THESE ARE SOLELY REFERENCES). There will be maps with puzzles and giant or bizarre, eerie enemies. Worlds where you constantly change themes as you pass through portals and complete levels.

HUMOR:

This game features black and green humor, primarily a mockery of politics, including both its representatives and followers. This game does not aim to defend any ideology or political stance, nor does it intend to offend or discriminate. Violent scenes should not be imitated or referenced in real life; this content is designed to entertain and raise awareness simultaneously with a violent, murky, cold humor. References and mockery of Hitler's dysfunctional party are solely jokes and parodies, and the same applies to other regimes or countries that may appear. We maintain a professional work environment and are proudly Latino, embracing diversity.

VIOLENCE:

Our images or textures are created by artists, or sourced from pictures of raw pork chops from supermarkets or the internet, free of any copyright.

SEXUAL CONTENT:

Throughout the game's story, there will be provocative scenes with female characters. We do not want any child to touch or try this game due to its violence and sexual content. Please keep children away from any trace of this game. Female characters will be provocative as a form of satire or parody, a common cliché in many sagas or films (this does NOT apply to all female characters).

  • NOTICE: Mockery of clichés, movies, politics, and other things will only be part of the game's humor, with no intention to offend or discriminate. The actions shown should not be idealized or, much less, recreated. We do not support any political position or are blind followers. If you find this content annoying, immature, or in bad taste, we sincerely apologize. Please understand that it's part of the game's humor and is just comedy; even if you don't like it, others might, and it's not necessarily bad—we just see or perceive things differently. Thank you for your attention.









    ⚠️ This game contains political satire, explicit violence, dark humor, and heavily altered representations of historical events for the purpose of social commentary. It does not glorify extremist ideologies, but mocks and criticizes them.

It all begins in the 1940s. Walt Disney secretly meets with the German dictator and proposes something insane: cryogenically freezing themselves to wake up in the future and see if they won the war. Hitler loves the idea and leaves his regime in the hands of his most loyal soldiers. Not to be outdone, the Soviet Union tries the same… but ends up failing miserably due to a lack of common sense. Spoiler: they die anyway.

But the war doesn’t end. No, it mutates. It becomes more absurd, more sadistic, more twisted. And by the 1990s—when the world should already be at peace—our protagonist appears: Shootman, a young man from Yemen who is captured during an anti-racism march. He’s used as a test subject in an attempt to create a so-called “superior race.” The experiment fails... but in their incompetence, the leftover Nazis accidentally bring him back to life with powers.

Meanwhile, aliens arrive. They see a planet corrupted by power, obsessed with race, and poisoned by failed ideologies—some born out of nothing more than failing an art school admission—and decide it’s ripe for invasion. They bring with them diseases, extreme pollution, and wild predators that threaten both humans and animals.

Prepare for a journey full of absurd, chaotic events, where you'll walk through hellish battlefields and face the resurrected German empire of the dictator. Shootman isn’t your typical hero, but he’s humanity’s last hope. He will fight for human rights, for equality, and for freedom, even if he has to crush every fanatic, monster, or walking corpse from the past to do it.

content_descriptors.notes: There are many parodic mockeries of serious topics such as drugs. It is a violent war game that also parodies regimes such as Hitler's, changing the name to: "The Dicktator." It is NOT suitable for children or adolescents.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS
  • Processor: A dual-core processor running at 2.0 GHz or faster. For FPS, something like a 4th-generation Intel Core i3 or a 1st-generation AMD Ryzen 3 might be a good starting point.
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: A dedicated graphics card with at least 2 GB of VRAM and support for DirectX 11 or OpenGL 4.5. Examples include an NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or an AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible sound card
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Linux Mint 19
  • Processor: A quad- or six-core (or higher) processor running at a higher frequency. For example, a 7th-generation Intel Core i5 or a 2nd-generation AMD Ryzen 5 or higher. This will ensure a smoother experience, especially in scenes with a lot of enemies or effects.
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: A graphics card with 4GB of VRAM or more and support for DirectX 11/12 or Vulkan. Examples include an NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) or an AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB). For more modern and demanding FPS games, even more powerful cards (RTX 30/40 series or RX 6000/7000 series) are recommended.
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible sound card
